title: trailboss --json thread --tree

root.description: The topmost session of the tree, `AGENT:ID`: following forks, sub-agents and started agents back from the session named.

session.description: The session the turn is in, `AGENT:ID`.

turn.description: The turn's number in its session, from 1, counting the session's prompts as `thread` does. A fork's copied turns are left out, so its first node keeps its number in the fork (after the copied ones).

parent.description: The node this one follows: the previous turn in the same session, or for a session's first turn, the turn it came out of. Null only for the root session's first turn.

edge.description: How this node follows its parent: "continues" (the next turn in the same session), or for a session's first turn "forked" (a fork of the parent's session), "subagent" (a sub-agent it spawned) or "started" (an agent or task started from it). Null only for the root session's first turn.

depth.description: 0 for the root session's turns; a branch's turns are one deeper than the turn it came out of.

prompt.description: The first line of the turn's prompt, at most 120 characters.

at_ms.description: When the prompt was sent, Unix milliseconds.

state.description: The session's live state, on its last turn only, while it runs: "working", "blocked" (waiting on you) or "done" (at rest after its turn). Null on other turns and for a session not running.

host.description: The host whose terminal runs the session, as `live` names it, on every turn of a running session.

terminal.description: That terminal, as `live` names it, on every turn of a running session.

nodes.description: One node per turn, in drawing order: depth first, a session's turns in order, a branch right after the turn it came out of. A session with no branches is a straight line.

description: The tree of work around one session: its turns, and the forks, sub-agents and agents or tasks that came out of them, each hanging from the turn that was running when it started. Read-only.
